**#person** — virtual patient demographics (doc/27, doc/28).

Fields: `name=`, `age=` (years, default 30), `sex=` (male | female), `weight=` (kg, default 70), `height=` (cm, default 170), `ethnicity=` (default european).
Stored in `Program.sim_extensions` under `person_` prefix.
Consumed by `#sim kind=human` when present.
